summary: Iteration 3 (Emergent storage uploads, admit-card PDF, Gmail SMTP emails) tested end-to-end. Backend: 52/52 pytest passing (38 prior + 14 new). Frontend: scholarship submission + PDF admit card download verified, Enroll FileUpload works (green checkmark + filename + Uploaded! toast), Jobs FileUpload replaced plain resume URL Input and submission succeeds, floating-whatsapp data-testid present on Scholarship/Enroll/Jobs.

minor.issue: Gmail SMTP intermittently returns '421 4.3.0 Temporary System Problem' for the admin notify recipient. Logged as ERROR but BackgroundTasks does not break HTTP response (endpoints still 200 < 5s). User-facing template emails (enrollment/scholarship/job-app receipts) succeeded in the same window. No code change needed.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~725 lines and growing — consider splitting routes into routers/<domain>.py for maintainability before adding more features.
/api/upload is intentionally public; OK for unauthenticated applicants but consider a per-IP rate limit to prevent storage abuse.
storage_client.put_object/get_object are sync requests inside async FastAPI handlers — for ~10MB files this blocks the event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor in a future iteration.
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES check happens AFTER the full body is read into memory; for 10MB this is acceptable, but a Content-Length pre-check would fail fast on hostile clients.

email_client uses smtplib synchronously inside BackgroundTasks (background tasks for sync funcs run in threadpool, which is fine). SMTP_PASSWORD is committed to backend/.env in plaintext — fine for preview but flag for production secret manager.
Frontend FileUpload reads file via FormData and sets manual fetch — good. No client-side size cap mirroring backend's 10MB; user gets a generic toast on 413. Minor UX nit.
test_credentials: admin@northend.edu / Admin@2025 (seeded). Student auto-registered per pid in tests.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_-prefixed scholarship/enrollment/job applications and uploaded files were created during testing. Cleanup not performed but data is namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 is fully green. /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py covers /api/upload (415/400/200), /api/files/{id}, /api/scholarship-applications/{no}/admit-card (PDF magic + 404), and email-side-effect endpoints (response < 15s with valid course_id/job_id, 404 for invalid). Combined regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/ → 52 passed in ~8s. Frontend verified via Playwright on /scholarship, /enroll, /jobs. Storage init logs 'Storage init OK' at startup. Gmail SMTP can flake with 421 for the admin recipient; this is benign because emails are fired via BackgroundTasks.
rca of the issue: No bugs requiring RCA in this iteration.
